reviews.title: Great graphics card for gaming
reviews.comment: I upgraded from a 3060 and I’m so glad that I did! I play BO6 it it runs the game great! You can over clock it and I’m just happy with it all around! A great upgrade plus now I can use Ray Tracing, it’s no louder than the 3060 and uses half the energy
reviews.author: Phillip J Wilsie

reviews.title: Very good GPU for the money!
reviews.comment: I used this card for 4 years straight before upgrading and I still have this card on the shelf! I ran most modern titles at 80fps plus and was overly impressed with this GPU!
reviews.author: Ethan b

reviews.title: What an upgrade
reviews.comment: Pny does it again! Great graphics card! Upgraded from a pny 1060 to this 4060. Omg! Great boost in performance and frame rates. Can play high end games on ultra settings with no lag. Couldn't do that before. And considering that other cards of same type from different manufacturers were twice the price. Very happy with the purchase and would buy again if the need is there.
reviews.author: Rockland Blake

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.comment: This card brought my 4 1/2 year old PC back to life.  I'm now running Starfield on Ultra settings with 4 second load times.  The computer runs quieter, cooler, and my son's high school friends think that it looks really awesome in the case.  It is a big card.  Check the dimensions to make sure it will fit.  I had to remove a spare HDD rack from the front of my case, but then it fit fine.
reviews.author: Michael Nowell
